# No Mongol or Seljuk invasion on a generated world: vanilla creates Temujin and
# House Seljuk from nothing. Written by Emit/VanillaIdentityWriter.cs.

on_game_start = {
	on_actions = {
		gen_no_historical_invasions
	}
}

gen_no_historical_invasions = {
	effect = {
		set_global_variable = { name = mongols_have_appeared value = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = seljuk_invasion_happened value = yes }
	}
}
